source.name: DTCC public price dissemination (SEC single names, CFTC indices)

method.model: ISDA flat-hazard, recovery 40%, discount = 5Y Treasury par - 75bp (swap proxy), accrued added back
method.liquid_rule: >=10 prints on >=4 days in the trailing 30 days
method.spread_rule: median of quoted prints when >=2 quoted, else median of quoted + sign-resolved derived prints; ambiguous prints counted but unpriced
method.sign_rule: evidence order: same-day quoted prints > two-coupon intersection > single feasible branch (uncapped) > trailing 7-day anchor > trailing 90-day two-coupon intersection > the name's own resolved level within 180 days (only when the two branches sit >e^1 apart) > index co-movement of the two branches over 150 days (>=20 day-pairs, corr >=0.3 vs <=0; inferred) > curve-shape (>=3y gap, <300bp); nothing else
method.universe_rule: every entity in the public tape is listed: priced names (liquid or thin) with a level, active-but-unpriced names (>=3 prints in 30 days) with both feasible branches, dormant names with their last dated level; sovereign coverage is measured against 119 known sovereign issuers
method.quote_rule: a Spread-Leg-1 value counts as a quote if it agrees with the print's own upfront; unconfirmed quotes must be >=5bp and within 50% log-distance of the name's trailing anchor (none available: accepted, sign evidence 'inferred')
method.stale_rule: levels older than 10 calendar days are not shown as current; such names appear in the unpriced list with their last dated level
method.package_rule: prints flagged as package transactions (index-arbitrage baskets) are counted but never priced
limitations: upfront sign is not disclosed; derived prints need an anchor
block notionals are capped (+) in the public file
public history begins 2024-09; nothing in the DTCC tape covers 2008 — the long view in data/cds-desk-history.json uses Moody's Baa-10Y, OFR FSI and Fed GZ/EBP records instead
clearinghouse settlement prices are not used (licence forbids republication)
method.curve_rule: off-the-run tenors enter the curve only when their own print fixes the sign (quoted, priced or single feasible branch); 5Y-1Y slope is same-day
method.unpriced_rule: active names whose sign cannot be fixed are listed with both feasible branches (median unsigned print read with the upfront paid by either side) and any dated earlier level

decision.basis: descriptive measurements of public prints only

term.note: 5Y minus 1Y spread from the same day's prints; an inverted single-name curve (1Y above 5Y) is the classic near-term distress signature
